fields.title: P2 comparability
fields.finding: P2 endpoints have different unqualified material, thermal, bond and life assumptions. 048 stopped at radius15.
fields.proposed_fix: Do not rank confidence from payload or axis count; any larger-radius 048 extension needs its own thermal and mechanical calculation.

claim: P2 endpoints have different unqualified material, thermal, bond and life assumptions. 048 stopped at radius15. | P2 comparability
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
